title: Union non-debt capital receipts
definition: Capital receipts that do not create public debt—comprising disinvestment/miscellaneous capital receipts and recovery of past loans and advances.

sources.title: RBI Bulletin — Union Budget 2025-26: An Assessment (Annex I)

points.evidence: RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I, row 'Non debt Capital Receipts', column 2022-23 (Actuals): 72 thousand crore INR (72,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I, row 'Non debt Capital Receipts', column 2023-24 (Actuals): 60 thousand crore INR (60,000 crore INR).
RBI Bulletin Union Budget 2025-26 Assessment, Annex I, row 'Non debt Capital Receipts', column 2024-25 (RE): 59 thousand crore INR (59,000 crore INR).
points.estimate_method: Compiled from official Union Budget documents (Revised Estimates / Budget Estimates) in RBI Bulletin.
